mara_arrival.title: Mara · beside the fountain
mara_arrival.text:
“We promised to help lift the crossing beam this morning. Then the pump stopped.”

Mara sets down two buckets, carefully, as if the water has already cost enough.

“The workshop has a spare regulator. Ivo thinks the service lever needs holding while someone fits it. The buckets will do for now. Take your time.”

ivo_arrival.title: Ivo · the waiting beam
ivo_arrival.text:
“One person can move a bucket. The beam needs several of us together.”

Ivo nods toward the green pump room.

“That spring lever won't stay up on its own. Try the echo spool or the long-reach coupler on the workbench. Spare regulator's on the rack.”

mara_deferred.title: Mara · another round
mara_deferred.text:
“We made another round with the buckets while you were up on the path.”

Mara checks that every lid is seated.

“We haven't gathered the crew yet. Once the water's sorted, we'll take another look at the crossing.”

ivo_deferred.title: Ivo · a place kept ready
ivo_deferred.text:
“The beam is still here. So is the work.”

Ivo has covered the lifting ropes to keep the damp out.

“We've been busy with the buckets. I'll keep these dry until we can get everyone together.”

mara_crossing.title: Mara · at the crossing
mara_crossing.text:
“Hear that? Water reaching the courtyard.”

The buckets are stacked beneath the shelter. Mara has both hands on the lifting rope now.

“We can fill a jug here instead of carrying it all the way from the lake. So we can finally do this together.”

ivo_crossing.title: Ivo · a shared lift
ivo_crossing.text:
“The beam didn't get lighter.”

Ivo smiles toward the people taking their places along the rope.

“We just got our hands back. I thought we'd be carrying buckets all afternoon.”

pump_broken.title: The communal pump
pump_broken.text:
The housing is lake-green under years of careful touch-ups. One brass coupling is newer than the others. A repaired plate sits slightly proud of its frame.

Inside, a cracked regulator has stopped the courtyard supply. A maintenance note gives the sequence: take the spare regulator; use a tool to hold the service bypass open; then fit the replacement at the bypass.

Both tools are on the workbench. A small inspection opening gives a second route to the spring lever.

pump_restored.title: Water finds its way
pump_restored.text:
A low vibration settles into the housing. Water returns to the fountain outside.

The replacement regulator sits beside someone else's older repair. For a moment the layers of work are easy to see.

The upper path leads to the archive. When you come back to the courtyard, look for Mara and Ivo at the crossing.

bench.title: The workbench · choose a tool
bench.text:
Two borrowed tools wait on a worn cloth.

Echo spool: record the service lever, then replay that movement at the bypass. Its echo loops steadily until you release it.

Long-reach coupler: hold the same lever through the inspection opening beside the bypass.

Either leaves your hands free to fit the spare regulator. You can change tools here; putting a tool back releases its hold.

archive.title: Archive fragment · a correction kept
archive.text:
TEST 14 — “Pressure stable. Repair complete.”

Beneath it, in a different hand:

“Correction: stable with one tap open. At the evening refill the pressure fell again. Do not repeat our claim. Test the farthest tap while the courtyard draws water.”

A later note is pinned through both sheets:

“Kept the first report beside the correction. It shows the condition we forgot to ask about. Whoever comes next should not have to lose the same afternoon.”

On the back: “What else have we called finished before everyone had arrived?”

plaque.title: A small inscription
plaque.text:
THE OBSERVATORY

“Leave the correction where the next person can find it.”

Below the carved words are shallow marks where an older plate once sat.

return_deferred.title: Return to the courtyard?
return_deferred.text:
The pump still needs its repair. Down in the courtyard, the residents will be making another round with the buckets.

Head back to see them? The lakeside bench offers a rest, and the workshop will still be there if you want to finish the repair.

return_repaired.title: Return to the courtyard?
return_repaired.text:
The supply is running. By the time you reach the courtyard, the residents should have put down their buckets and gathered at the crossing.

Head back to see how they're getting on? You can visit the archive again whenever you like.

arrive_deferred.title: The work that continues
arrive_deferred.text:
Mara and Ivo are still tending the buckets. The crossing beam waits under its cover.

People have kept the settlement supplied while you were away. The workshop is open, and there is a quiet seat down by the lake.

arrive_repaired.title: Hands for the crossing
arrive_repaired.text:
The buckets are stacked and the crew has moved to the crossing. The fountain keeps running behind them.

There are enough people to lift the beam together now. Down by the lake, the bench faces both the crossing and the water.

ending_deferred.title: By the lake · a visit left open
ending_deferred.text:
Across the water, a bucket knocks softly against a stone step. The settlement continues through many small efforts.

The pump remains unfinished. So does the crossing. Someone has folded the lifting ropes out of the rain.

From here, you can still see the workshop door.

ending_repaired.title: By the lake · room for the next thing
ending_repaired.text:
Water runs in the courtyard. At the crossing, several people lean into the same rope.

A few buckets sit forgotten beside the fountain. For once, nobody needs to pick them up.

Beyond the lake, the old observatory catches the last light. What other work is waiting inside?
